fold:meta.title: Masu box
fold:meta.technique: Blintz fold, opening flat paper into 3D
fold:meta.blurb: A square measuring box with no glue. The first model that stands up off the table.

fold:steps.title: Fold in half and unfold
fold:steps.text: Fold the paper in half edge to edge, then open it again.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Fold in half the other way
fold:steps.text: Fold in half the other way and unfold. The creases cross at the centre.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Fold the corners to the centre
fold:steps.text: Fold all four corners in so their points meet at the centre.
fold:steps.tip: fold every corner to the centre, making a smaller square

fold:steps.title: Crease the top and bottom
fold:steps.text: Fold the top and bottom edges to the centre line, then unfold.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Crease the sides
fold:steps.text: Fold the left and right edges to the centre line, then unfold.
fold:steps.tip: fold toward you, crease firmly, then unfold

fold:steps.title: Open two corners
fold:steps.text: Unfold the top and bottom corners so their points stick out again.
fold:steps.tip: open a fold you made earlier; the crease stays

fold:steps.title: Raise the walls
fold:steps.text: Lift the sides and ends up straight; the corners fold in on their creases.
fold:steps.tip: let the paper fold along creases you already made

fold:steps.title: Lock the top end
fold:steps.text: Fold the top flap over the wall and down inside, so its point lies on the floor.
fold:steps.tip: fold a flap over a wall so it holds the box together

fold:steps.title: Lock the bottom end
fold:steps.text: Do the same at the other end. The box holds itself together.
fold:steps.tip: fold a flap over a wall so it holds the box together

fold:step.text: Fold the paper in half edge to edge, then open it again.

file_frames.frame_title: Fold in half the other way

fold:step.text: Fold in half the other way and unfold. The creases cross at the centre.

file_frames.frame_title: Fold the corners to the centre

fold:step.text: Fold all four corners in so their points meet at the centre.
Fold the top and bottom edges to the centre line, then unfold.
Fold the left and right edges to the centre line, then unfold.
Unfold the top and bottom corners so their points stick out again.
Lift the sides and ends up straight; the corners fold in on their creases.
Fold the top flap over the wall and down inside, so its point lies on the floor.
Do the same at the other end. The box holds itself together.
